name: og-31-protometabolism-to-amphiphiles
title: Protometabolism to Amphiphiles
claim: The actual carbon products of the spatially integrated protometabolism can, through modeled chain extension, headgroup generation and hydrolysis, yield amphiphile mixtures that reach an experimentally measured critical-aggregation / phase-stability window WITHOUT any exogenous amphiphile feed — or they fall short of that window, which is reported. No membrane-former is assumed into existence.
question: Can actual metabolic products — not supplied amphiphiles — yield membrane-forming amphiphile mixtures under vent-local conditions?
hypothesis: Carbon-chain extension, headgroup generation and competing hydrolysis acting on the real product pool from study 30 will produce a chain-length and headgroup distribution whose concentration reaches the measured critical aggregation concentration and a stable phase window; if losses (hydrolysis, dilution) keep concentrations below that window, no assembly is claimed.
objective: Transform the study-30 precursor pool via modeled chain-extension/headgroup/hydrolysis chemistry, track chain-length and headgroup distributions, concentrations and losses, and test against measured critical aggregation and phase-stability data — with zero exogenous amphiphile input.
proposed_mechanisms: carbon-chain extension from real metabolic precursors
headgroup generation and competing hydrolysis / degradation losses
concentration vs the measured critical aggregation concentration (CAC) and phase window
proposed_models_methods: RDKit chain-extension / headgroup generation + precursor enumeration   [to-build: viva_reaction_atlas]
OpenMM/LAMMPS composition-dependent assembly + permeability closure     [to-build: viva_md_membrane]
PubChem / ORD amphiphile species identities and properties
measured CAC / phase-stability benchmarks for independent validation (evidence standard

model_approach.prose: Study 31 is where chemistry meets compartment, and the hard rule is evidence standard #2: no untracked amphiphile feed. Every amphiphile must come from the study-30 product pool through explicit modeled chemistry, with hydrolysis and dilution as real sinks. The assembly claim is tested against measured critical aggregation concentrations and phase windows, not a chosen threshold — if the modeled pool never reaches the experimental window, the study reports that the vent-local chemistry is insufficient on its own, and names what is missing.

conditions.name: no_exogenous_amphiphile
conditions.expr: all amphiphiles derive from the network's carbon products (no untracked amphiphile feed)

conditions.name: carbon_mass_balance
conditions.expr: chain extension + headgroup + hydrolysis conserve carbon (balanced against supply)

behavior_tests.name: receives-30-handoff-bundle
behavior_tests.description: Study 31 receives the full 30→31 bundle — spatially local precursor concentrations, T, pH, residence time and competing sinks — as typed inputs, verified complete before the amphiphile chemistry.

behavior_tests.name: no-untracked-amphiphile-feed
behavior_tests.description: Every amphiphile in the model is produced from the study-30 product pool via explicit chain-extension/headgroup chemistry; no exogenous amphiphile is fed, and hydrolysis/dilution losses are tracked.

measure.detail: amphiphile mass ledger — fraction traceable to the study-30 pool (target 1.0); exogenous feed (target 0)

pass_if.detail: no untracked amphiphile feed; losses tracked

behavior_tests.name: reaches-measured-assembly-window
behavior_tests.description: The modeled chain-length/headgroup distribution either reaches the experimentally measured critical aggregation concentration and a stable phase window, or it falls short; the finding reports which, with the distributions, concentrations and losses.

measure.detail: endogenous amphiphile concentration + chain-length/headgroup distribution vs. measured CAC + phase window

pass_if.detail: concentration reaches the measured assembly window (else a reported shortfall)

behavior_tests.name: handoff-31-to-32-complete

pass_if.detail: bundle complete and typed (satisfies 31→32 handoff validator)

decision_test: The model must reach an experimentally measured assembly window (critical aggregation + phase stability) using ONLY amphiphiles produced from real metabolic products — no exogenous amphiphile feed (evidence standard #2). Falling short of the measured window is an accepted negative result that names the missing chemistry, reported not tuned (evidence standard #6, #8).
